lead: The app's sidebar shell: a header, scrollable content (holding a [SideMenu](/side-menu)) and a footer, in three looks (`sidebar`, `floating`, `inset`) × three ways to collapse (`offcanvas`, `icon`, `none`). On narrow screens it becomes a drawer; it also has a toggle button, an edge rail and a keyboard shortcut. Each theme style gives it its own look.

usage.title: Usage
usage.body: A header, a scrollable menu and the user in the footer; on narrow screens it becomes a drawer.

app.title: Full example
app.description: A complete app shell: menu data (groups, submenus, a divider), the selected item, closing the drawer after a pick on narrow screens, a logo in the header (`Sidebar.Label` leaves only the icon when collapsed), an avatar in the footer, `Rail` and `Trigger`. The code below can be copied as it is; it persists the expanded state itself (`localStorage`), the library stores nothing. The demo here leaves out `localStorage` and `100svh`.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `sidebar` sits against the page edge; `floating` is a floating rounded card; `inset` blends the sidebar into the background, with the main content as a rounded card.

collapsible.title: Collapsible
collapsible.description: `icon` collapses to a narrow icon rail (the menu collapses with it, with tooltips on hover); `offcanvas` slides the whole panel out, and the collapsed panel is `inert`.
collapsible.hint: Click the button at the top left, or press Ctrl / ⌘ + B.

footer-trigger.title: Footer trigger
footer-trigger.description: `Sidebar.Trigger` on its own in `Sidebar.Footer`: in the antd theme style it is a full-width collapse bar at the bottom of the sidebar (as in antd's `Layout.Sider`); the other theme styles show a plain icon button.
footer-trigger.body: The collapse button is at the bottom of the sidebar

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Without `theme` the theme style's default is used (dark in antd, light in the others); `theme` forces light or dark, and the SideMenu inside follows.

api.title: API Reference
api.header: Header (logo, workspace switcher), scrollable content (holds the SideMenu), footer (user info)
api.label: Text in the header / footer shown only when expanded (the name after the logo icon, the user name): visually hidden on the icon rail, leaving only the icon, still read by screen readers
api.inset: The main content area; it scrolls on its own
api.trigger: The toggle button (expand / collapse on desktop, open / close the drawer on mobile; named “Toggle sidebar” by default); `Rail` is a thin strip on the sidebar's edge, for the mouse only, not in the Tab order
api.useSidebar: Inside the Provider: read the state and toggle it yourself (e.g. `setOpenMobile(false)` to close the drawer after a menu pick on mobile)
api.provider: The shell: holds expanded / collapsed (controlled or uncontrolled), the mobile drawer state and the shortcut, and lays the sidebar and the main content out side by side. Its height comes from outside; the main area scrolls on its own.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.provider: The shell; `data-width`; reads `--_w` / `--_wi` (icon rail width) / `--_pad` (outer margin of `floating` and `inset`)
styling.sidebar: The sidebar root; `data-state` (expanded / collapsed), `data-collapsible` (only when collapsed), `data-variant`, `data-side`
styling.gap: The spacer (pushes the main content aside) and the panel against the edge
styling.inner: The panel itself (`aside`); `data-theme`; the one in the mobile drawer has `data-mobile`
styling.label: Text in the header / footer shown only when expanded; visually hidden on the icon rail (still read by screen readers)
styling.inset: The main content; a rounded card in the `inset` look
styling.trigger: The toggle button and the edge rail
